text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps teams track progress and stay motivated. Deliverables are the tangible results you promise to produce, such as reports or products. It is also important to align with stakeholders—the people who care about the project—so everyone agrees on what success looks like. When goals, milestones, and deliverables are clear, and stakeholders are aligned, projects run more smoothly and are more likely to succeed.
